assertion.rationale: F1: data-api's external boundary (ingressExternal: true) has no inbound authentication, so the estate's external communications boundary is neither monitored nor controlled for anyone who discovers the FQDN. F2: mcp-tools' external boundary is required to stay open (Copilot Studio calls it from the internet); the auth gate meant to protect that boundary was inert in the shipped configuration, so the control the repo advertises most prominently at its key internal/external boundary was not actually enforced. Task 4 closed the application half of F2: enforcement no longer keys off backendMode, so the gate now fails closed at this boundary by default in every mode, and is mounted ahead of the body parser so an unauthenticated caller cannot make the process do work before the boundary check runs. F2 itself is NOT closed — MLS_TOOL_BACKENDS is still never set explicitly in infra/ or CI and the token is still not resolved from Key Vault, so the boundary's enforcement still depends on an operator remembering a step nothing in infra/ forces; Task 5 is pending.

recommendation: Set ingressExternal:false on data-api so it is no longer an external boundary at all. Invert the MCP auth gate default and wire MLS_TOOL_BACKENDS plus Key Vault token resolution so the boundary that must legitimately stay external (mcp-tools) is actually protected.
